about: Every model configuration backtested for a strategy, so the Deflated Sharpe Ratio knows how many were tried. Add each new configuration here, with its run, in the same reviewed change that adds it. Never delete a trial. See docs/research-protocol.md.

C.holdoutNote: Everything before this date has already been seen while designing quant-c-v1 and v2, so the holdout is the period after the protocol was written. Its result is looked at once per model and recorded in holdoutRuns.
C.approvalNote: Set only in a reviewed change, by the person, once a backtest of this exact configuration passes gate-v2: {"configHash": ..., "approvedBy": ..., "date": ..., "run": ..., "reason": ...}. Any change to the model's settings changes its hash and needs a new approval.

B.holdoutNote: Strategy B's moat screen (moat-v1) was designed on 2026-11-03 without looking at any backtest. Days from this date on are the holdout.
B.approvalNote: Strategy B trades come from the research committee (keers.agents), gated by the moat screen and the risk limits. This field is kept for symmetry with C; the moat backtest does not open or close any gate.
